class.name: rover_manager::GotoPrimitive
class.description: Point-to-point navigation primitive via Nav2 NavigateToPose. Accepts coordinates (x,y,yaw) or TF frame names.

class.name: rover_manager::ReturnToBasePrimitive
class.description: Return to home/base position. Home is configurable as coordinates or TF frame via YAML parameters.

class.name: rover_manager::CoverAreaPrimitive
class.description: Area coverage using boustrophedon decomposition. Generates a lawn-mower path over a polygon and executes it waypoint by waypoint. Parametric swath width and angle.
Reads a TF frame's pose in 'map' and publishes it on rock_pose.
